note: Closed assetRole vocabulary. Every media-bearing field in schema/pagespec.schema.json references this enum; no section exposes a bare 'image'/'src' string.

generationPolicyMeaning.may-generate-new: An AI generator may synthesise a new asset for this role, provided it respects the role's geometry and the licensing rules below.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-reuse-exact: The generator must reference one of the existing local files listed for this role. It may not synthesise a replacement.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-reproduce-real-mark: HARD BAN. This role covers a real third party's or the subject company's registered mark, or a real identifiable person. The generator must not emit the file, a copy, a recreation, or an imitation of it, and the section contract deliberately exposes no field for it.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-fabricate: HARD BAN on synthesis. This role covers operative or legally significant content. The generator must not write, paraphrase, summarise or 'restore' it. Only a human content/legal owner may supply it.
generationPolicyMeaning.operator-supplied: The asset is supplied (and licensed) by whoever deploys the generated page. The design-repo carries no file for it; assetRef is an operator/ reference the deployer resolves.

pinnedPolicies.note: These roles are PINNED to a specific policy value, not merely constrained to the enum. verify_all.py enforces each pinned pairing exactly, and schema/tests/adversarial_test.py proves a mutation to a DIFFERENT-BUT-VALID enum member is rejected. Membership-in-a-closed-set is a weaker claim than 'this role must have this value', and these four roles carry real legal weight.

sourceIsARealCompany.statement: withotter.com is a real, live company's website. The cloned project contains that company's real proprietary content. Nothing in this design-repo licenses reuse of it.
mustNeverBeReproducedOrFabricated: Real third-party press logos — the press bar carries actual Forbes, The New York Times, Parents and mom.com marks (public/img/forbes.svg, NYT.svg, parents.svg, mom.svg). A generator must never emit these or imitations of them.
The Otter wordmark and brand illustrations — real brand assets.
Real people's photographs — several assets are photographs of actual people.

Operative legal text — src/data/legal/terms.js and privacy.js hold the site's real legal copy, ported verbatim. This is operative legal text requiring sign-off from whoever owns legal/content before any real deployment. A generator must never fabricate or paraphrase legal clauses.
sourceIsARealCompany.doNotPublish: This design-repo is not to be made public and nothing in it is to be published.

asset.operatorSupplied.generatedModeGuidance: An asset the DEPLOYER supplies and licenses (their own mark, photo, illustration, legal document). The design-repo ships no file; assetRef is an operator/ reference the deployer resolves.
asset.operatorSupplied.geometry: inherits the geometry of the slot it fills
asset.operatorSupplied.aiGuidance: An asset the DEPLOYER supplies and licenses (their own mark, photo, illustration, legal document). The design-repo ships no file; assetRef is an operator/ reference the deployer resolves.

auth.illustration.geometry: hard 400px wide at every width; at 390 it overflows the 326px column to x = -5 and is clipped by overflow-x:hidden — that is the original's behaviour
auth.illustration.aiGuidance: Reuse by path only. Belongs to the auth design system, not the marketing one.
auth.illustration.generatedModeGuidance: The source app's illustration. Use illustration.generated or asset.operatorSupplied.

blob.fill.geometry: a 1:1 div clipped by one of the 7 closed clip-path ids, filled with a foundation colour; no image file
blob.fill.fieldShape: { assetRole: "blob.fill", clipId: "<one of the 7 ids>", fill: "<foundation colour token>", rotate90: <bool> }
blob.fill.aiGuidance: This is the one role a generator may freely compose, because it carries no third-party content: pick any of the 7 closed clip ids, any measured foundation fill, and optionally rotate 90deg. It may NOT invent new path data.
blob.fill.generatedModeGuidance: Generation-safe: a closed clip-path id plus a foundation colour token. No source content.

brand.wordmark.geometry: inline SVG, viewBox 0 0 139 48; 128px wide in the nav, 112px at <=479
files: inline SVG in src/components/OtterWordmark.jsx and src/components/auth/AuthWordmark.jsx
brand.wordmark.reason: Chrome-owned; the nav and footer always render it. A PageSpec cannot set it.
brand.wordmark.generatedModeGuidance: Never the Otter wordmark or a look-alike. Declare generationContext.brandMark with placeholder.brandMark (a neutral placeholder mark) or asset.operatorSupplied (the deployer's own mark).

copy.original.generatedModeGuidance: All text in a generated page is original copy for the fictional brand. Source headings, taglines, claims, stats, legal text and blog titles are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_COPY / _CLAIM.
copy.original.aiGuidance: All text in a generated page is original copy for the fictional brand. Source headings, taglines, claims, stats, legal text and blog titles are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_COPY / _CLAIM.
copy.original.fieldShape: any text field in a mode:generation PageSpec

decorative.none.aiGuidance: Explicit 'no asset in this slot'. Several real slots on the original carry alt="" decorative images or nothing at all; this role lets a PageSpec say so instead of inventing one.

editorial.cover.geometry: blog card cover, and a forced 1:1 post-header cover with a 32px radius at every breakpoint, object-fit contain
editorial.cover.fieldShape: { assetRole: "editorial.cover", assetRef: "<one of the listed local paths>" }
editorial.cover.aiGuidance: The 10 real blog titles, covers and tags are genuine company content. Reuse covers by path; do not synthesise new covers for real article titles.
editorial.cover.provenanceNote: The article BODIES in src/data/posts.js are original placeholder prose written for the clone, deliberately NOT the original articles. Do not mistake placeholders for source content and do not attempt to 'restore' the originals.
editorial.cover.generatedModeGuidance: Real blog covers (one is a product screenshot). Use illustration.generated, screenshot.placeholder or asset.operatorSupplied; never a cover for a real Otter article title.

icon.feature.fieldShape: { assetRole: "icon.feature", assetRef: "<one of the listed local paths>" }
icon.feature.aiGuidance: Reuse by path only. payment.webp carries width="96" as an HTML attribute, which is why it renders narrower than the 104px cap — preflight being off means that attribute wins.
icon.feature.generatedModeGuidance: Source icon artwork. Use illustration.generated (new icon art) or asset.operatorSupplied.

icon.values.fieldShape: { assetRole: "icon.values", assetRef: "<one of the listed local paths>" }
icon.values.generatedModeGuidance: Source icon artwork. Use illustration.generated or asset.operatorSupplied.

illustration.brand.geometry: flat SVG; Playdate.svg renders 291.2x180 from its height="180" attribute
illustration.brand.fieldShape: { assetRole: "illustration.brand", assetRef: "<one of the listed local paths>" }
illustration.brand.aiGuidance: Reuse by path only. These are the real company's brand illustrations.
illustration.brand.preflightNote: Tailwind preflight is off, so there is no img{height:auto}. An illustration sized by CSS width alone needs an explicit height or its HTML height attribute wins.
illustration.brand.generatedModeGuidance: The source company's brand illustrations. Use illustration.generated (new original art) or asset.operatorSupplied.

illustration.editorial.geometry: webp, used as the careers image-copy split and the how-it-works illustration
illustration.editorial.fieldShape: { assetRole: "illustration.editorial", assetRef: "<one of the listed local paths>" }
illustration.editorial.generatedModeGuidance: Source editorial illustrations. Use illustration.generated or asset.operatorSupplied.

illustration.generated.generatedModeGuidance: Newly generated original artwork (illustration, icon, cover art). Must not imitate the source's brand illustrations or icons.
illustration.generated.geometry: inherits the geometry of the slot it fills
illustration.generated.aiGuidance: Newly generated original artwork (illustration, icon, cover art). Must not imitate the source's brand illustrations or icons.

legal.operativeText.reason: The legal-prose section exposes a documentRef (an enum of the two real documents) and NO body field. A PageSpec cannot carry legal prose, so a generator has nothing to fabricate into.
legal.operativeText.measuredSize: terms: ~56,170 characters of concatenated document strings across 25 top-level sections; privacy: ~23,964 characters across 12. Measured by importing the modules and concatenating every string value, so these figures include structural strings (hrefs, block type tags) and are an upper bound on the body text itself.
legal.operativeText.signOffRequired: Operative legal text. Requires sign-off from whoever owns legal/content before any real deployment.
legal.operativeText.generatedModeGuidance: Never generated or paraphrased. A generated legal page points documentRef at "operator-supplied": the deployer's own legal owner supplies the text.

logo.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: A placeholder company / publication / customer logo for a fictional organisation. Never a real third-party mark.
logo.placeholder.geometry: inherits the geometry of the slot it fills
logo.placeholder.aiGuidance: A placeholder company / publication / customer logo for a fictional organisation. Never a real third-party mark.

media.videoPoster.aiGuidance: Poster only. The player is a click-to-play facade: a generated instance must not autoplay, must not embed an iframe or <video> on load, and must not issue a third-party request before a user click.
media.videoPoster.generatedModeGuidance: The source video's poster frame. Use screenshot.placeholder / illustration.generated / asset.operatorSupplied, and set generationContext.videoEmbedUrl to a placeholder URL.

person.fictional.generatedModeGuidance: A generated image or avatar of a FICTIONAL person. Never a real, identifiable person, never a re-render of a source photograph.
person.fictional.geometry: inherits the geometry of the slot it fills
person.fictional.aiGuidance: A generated image or avatar of a FICTIONAL person. Never a real, identifiable person, never a re-render of a source photograph.

photo.person.geometry: varies; always inside a 1:1 .u-aspect-1x1 with object-fit: contain, or a bare width-limited img
photo.person.fieldShape: { assetRole: "photo.person", assetRef: "<one of the listed local paths>" }
photo.person.aiGuidance: A PageSpec may REFERENCE one of these existing local files by path. It must not generate a new photograph of a person, and must not describe, caption or re-render an identifiable person. Several of these are photographs of actual people.
photo.person.generatedModeGuidance: Real photographs (some of real people). Use person.fictional (a generated image of a fictional person), illustration.generated, or asset.operatorSupplied.

placeholder.brandMark.generatedModeGuidance: A neutral placeholder brand mark (text-free geometric mark or the fictional brand's name set in the site's display font). Never the Otter otter glyph or wordmark, never an imitation.
placeholder.brandMark.geometry: inherits the geometry of the slot it fills
placeholder.brandMark.aiGuidance: A neutral placeholder brand mark (text-free geometric mark or the fictional brand's name set in the site's display font). Never the Otter otter glyph or wordmark, never an imitation.

press.logo.reason: The press-bar section exposes only an eyebrow and a logo COUNT. There is deliberately no field a generator can populate with a mark.
press.logo.generatedModeGuidance: Never Forbes / The New York Times / Parents / mom.com marks or imitations. A generated home page declares generationContext.pressLogos with logo.placeholder entries (fictional publications), one per press-bar logo slot.

screenshot.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: A placeholder product screenshot / video poster (neutral wireframe or generated UI). Never a capture of the Otter app or site.
screenshot.placeholder.geometry: inherits the geometry of the slot it fills
screenshot.placeholder.aiGuidance: A placeholder product screenshot / video poster (neutral wireframe or generated UI). Never a capture of the Otter app or site.

url.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Any URL in a generated page (CTA href, app host, social link, job link, mailto, embed) must sit on a reserved .example or .invalid domain (RFC 2606 / RFC 6761).
url.placeholder.aiGuidance: Any URL in a generated page (CTA href, app host, social link, job link, mailto, embed) must sit on a reserved .example or .invalid domain (RFC 2606 / RFC 6761).
url.placeholder.fieldShape: any href / url string in a mode:generation PageSpec

assetInventory.verification: grep -rnE 'https?://[^\"'\" ]*\.(webp|png|jpe?g|svg|woff2?|mp4)' src/ returns nothing — re-run and confirmed empty during this build. All 83 images and 6 fonts are served locally.

availabilityMeaning.clone-only: May be used ONLY in a mode:"clone" PageSpec (a faithful reconstruction of the source). A mode:"generation" PageSpec must use one of generationSafeSubstitutes instead (GENERATION_MODE_ASSET).
availabilityMeaning.generation-safe: Carries no source identity or proprietary content. Usable in both modes.
availabilityMeaning.blocked-for-generation: Never usable in a mode:"generation" PageSpec, and not settable as a PageSpec field in either mode (chrome/contract-owned). A generated page substitutes it through generationContext or a generation-safe role.

modes.clone: A faithful reconstruction of the source (withotter.com). Real source assets and copy may be referenced for fidelity, within each role's generationPolicy (existing files only, never synthesised).
modes.generation: A new page for a DIFFERENT brand built from this design-repo. Only generation-safe roles; no source brand, customer/press marks, people, screenshots, copy, claims, URLs or embeds. Every URL must sit on a reserved .example or .invalid domain. The chrome-owned identity (wordmark, app host, social links, press marks, video embed) is substituted through PageSpec.generationContext. Enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py GENERATION_MODE_* rules.

pinnedAvailability.note: Pinned in code as PINNED_AVAILABILITY in BOTH extraction/verify_all.py and schema/semantic_validate.py; editing this registry alone cannot loosen a role. verify_all cross-checks registry == both pins == allowlist.
